stages.title: The model's reply

stages.title: What the Engine kept from the reply
stages.summary: The Engine keeps the first NOTE line (at most 400 characters) and the STATE word; the rest of the reply is not stored in the Thought. A NOTE that is too short or only repeats the inputs is refused. The STATE word is only a suggestion: no code path applies it.
stages.text_label: The saved Note (the kept NOTE line)

stages.title: Saved and checked
stages.summary: Core's receipt verified exactly one saved Note and one developed step with this request ID. That shows it was saved, not that it answers the question.

stages.title: Memory search
stages.summary: A nudge does not search memory. The Engine builds the prompt from the Thought's question, its evidence summaries and its newest 5 Notes.

stages.title: Tools, skills or notebooks
stages.summary: No tool, skill or notebook runs in this path. The reply is only read for a NOTE and a STATE line; a Note that describes an action is not evidence the action happened.

stages.title: The model's reasoning
stages.summary: This request is sent with thinking off (CODE-DEFINED), so no reasoning text exists to show. Nothing is inferred in its place.
